$comment: The source of sf-reference-link's element plumbing (core/js/element-manifest.js). Taken from simai/ui-control control/smart-architecture/migration/out/reference-link (migration/convert-1.3.8.mjs over simai/ui-source@5100227); standard simai.smart-component 1.3.8, vocabulary 1.1.5. Every x-todo of the conversion is decided: x-decisions says how.

icon.summary: Absent: the arrow; empty: no icon at all

default.$comment: The Lit template in JavaScript, the migration form of §5.2 (§16): the build does not compile template.html yet, so a second copy of the markup would only drift from the one that draws.

accessibility.$comment: The link is a native <a> inside the card while href is set and the reference is not disabled; otherwise the label is plain text and the card says aria-disabled when disabled.

x-summary: Navigation surface that pairs a real destination with a compact reference.
x-renamed: settings.aria-label: a host attribute, read by the base, never a setting (§3.1)

ai_guidance.use_when: Use sf-reference-link when a real destination benefits from a visible route, source or other compact reference.
do_not: Do not use Reference Link for a generic action or a plain text link
Do not render an enabled reference without href
Do not leave href on a disabled reference
Do not open a new context without disclosing it in the accessible name
Do not copy generated ui-smart code
Do not move host data or access decisions into the component

x-decisions: a11y-role: link, the native <a> the template draws while href is set and the reference is not disabled (Enter follows it, Tab reaches it); without href, or disabled, the label is plain text and nothing takes focus. The name is the host's aria-label, else the label or its slot (§4.8).
icon is optional (§4.2) and keeps its getter: absent is the arrow, an empty attribute is no icon at all, which a string default cannot say.
size and line keep their getters: they map a form size onto the field-size ladder (fieldSize) before the class list reads it.
aria-label is a host attribute, never a setting (§3.1); the template reads it from the host.
template: templates.default names the Lit template js/templates/default.js, the migration form §5.2 allows; no template.html until the build compiles one (a copy nothing draws would drift).
examples: examples.json from studio.fixture.json (Документация, #) plus a label and text, plain, no icon, a size, a line and disabled.

css-variables: seven public variables (fill and border at rest, radius, link colour, padding inline and block, gap), read by the class sheet with the internal token as fallback (§6) and listed in src/core/contracts/public-variables.v1.json.
version 1.0.0: the interface is unchanged; nothing is renamed, so aliases.json holds only the host attribute aria-label.
